subject: Chemistry
topics: Physical and Chemical Changes of Matter

definitions.definition: A process in which the nature and identity of the initial substance change
The substances that undergo chemical change in a reaction
The new substance formed during a chemical reaction
A representation of a chemical reaction using words, with reactants on the LHS and products on the RHS
A concise representation of a chemical equation using symbols for elements
A chemical equation where the number of atoms of each element is the same on both sides of the arrow
A method of balancing chemical equations by making trials to balance the equation using the smallest whole number coefficient
Notations (g), (l), (aq), and (s) used to represent gaseous, liquid, aqueous, and solid states of reactants and products in a chemical equation
A reaction in which two or more substances (elements or compounds) combine to form a single product.
A reaction that releases heat along with the formation of products.
A chemical reaction in which a single reactant breaks down into simpler products.
A type of decomposition reaction that occurs when a substance is heated, resulting in the breakdown of the substance into simpler products.
A chemical reaction in which one element displaces another element from a compound.
The process of using an electric current to drive a chemical reaction, often used to split a molecule into its constituent elements.
A chemical reaction that absorbs energy in the form of heat, light, or electricity
A chemical reaction that produces a precipitate, an insoluble solid formed in the reaction
The process of gaining oxygen during a chemical reaction
The process of losing oxygen during a chemical reaction
A type of redox reaction where there is an exchange of ions between the reactants, resulting in the formation of two new compounds
The process of a metal being attacked by substances around it, such as moisture, acids, etc., resulting in the formation of a coating on its surface.
The process of fats and oils becoming oxidised, leading to a change in their smell and taste.
A chemical reaction that releases heat energy.

Not drawing boxes around each formula
Incorrectly balancing elements
Changing the formulae of compounds or elements involved in the reactions
Not considering physical states of reactants and products
Not balancing the equation
Incorrectly identifying the type of reaction (combination, decomposition, etc.)
Failing to include state symbols in the balanced equation
Not accounting for heat transfer in the reaction

Do not add too much dilute sulphuric acid to the water.
Do not switch on the current without proper supervision.
